goal: J2: a two-child Initiative runs as parallel Lanes, integrates and passes final verification, or retains the branch when final verification fails (Spec D2, J2) (Initiative e2e-release-gate slice S6; Spec docs/specs/e2e-release-gate.spec.md).

acceptance.assertion: bun run e2e batch runs a two-child Initiative through parallel Lanes, integration and final verification to an integrated delivery. Negative case: a forced final-verification failure retains the integration branch and delivers nothing. Done looks like: tests/e2e/batch.e2e.ts passes with the negative asserted. Prerequisite: the pinned claude binary from tests/e2e/hosts.json is installed on the QA host (maintainer machine provides claude 2.1.330); an absent binary fails the check rather than skipping.
